export async function run(items, step) {
 await inOrder(items, step, {reason: ORDER_REASON});
 await inOrderSteps([step], {reason: ORDER_REASON});
}
const ORDER_REASON = 'Each update reads the previous write';
const reason = 'Each update reads the previous write';
inOrder(items, step, {reason, trace: false});
inOrderSteps([step], {trace: false, reason});
async function dynamic(items, step, reason) {
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
 await inOrder(items, step, {reason, trace: false});
}
async function tooShort(items, step) {
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
 await inOrder(items, step, {reason: SHORT_REASON});
}
const SHORT_REASON = 'too short';
